description: Changes an existing field, either its Directus metadata (interface, note, validation, options) or its database schema (type, required, unique, default_value). Metadata changes are safe; a type change rewrites the column and can fail or lose precision on existing data, and turning on required or unique fails on rows that already violate it. Idempotent: the same body applied twice leaves the same result. Use create_field to add a field, delete_field to remove one, and update_field with a hidden interface to retire a field without destroying data. Returns the updated field definition.
name: update_field
